## What's changed

- Added the first native Tater Tube Server app for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or newer.
- Added a dedicated menu bar experience for opening the dashboard, controlling the server, viewing logs and data, starting at login, and installing updates.
- Bundled the server dashboard, FFmpeg, ffprobe, and Apple VideoToolbox support so the Mac app does not require Docker or a separate media-tool installation.
- Added signed and notarized DMG installation plus checksum-verified in-app updates.
- Expanded setup guidance for local libraries and NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple hardware transcoding.

Docker and Unraid installations continue to work as before.
